title: feat(wrappers): agentCommand copilot launches GitHub Copilot CLI seats (headless stdin prompt, per-launch MCP config, TUI for architect/governor)
description:
Slice 2 of task-59e1d150 (GitHub Copilot CLI as a fifth agent provider; that row is the closing integration row with the signed-in smoke). Human request, 2026-11-05 ~19:25Z: "can we use copilot as agents?". dependsOn task-98053b89 (slice B of task-a200486f) because it also edits moe-agent.{sh,ps1} (the governor's edge).

OBJECTIVE. agentCommand `copilot` (the base name of any path, .exe/.cmd stripped) runs GitHub Copilot CLI (npm @github/copilot, binary `copilot`). Today moe-agent.sh about :632-647 and its ps1 twin type every other command as claude, so copilot gets claude's argv and cannot run.

FACTS measured 2026-11-05 on copilot 1.0.105 (scratch install, not signed in; the closing row re-checks them signed in):
- Non-interactive mode takes the prompt on stdin when -p is absent. With stdin at the null device it says "No prompt provided. Run in an interactive terminal or provide a prompt with -p or via standard in." So the prompt never rides argv (Windows caps a command line at 32 KB).
- These flags parse: -C <dir>, --allow-all (= --allow-all-tools --allow-all-paths --allow-all-urls; --allow-all-tools is required for non-interactive), --no-ask-user, --no-auto-update, --disable-builtin-mcps (github-mcp-server, githubiq), --additional-mcp-config @<file> (repeatable; augments ~/.copilot/mcp-config.json for one session), -i <prompt> (TUI that runs the prompt first).
- MCP JSON shape (copilot mcp add --json): {"mcpServers":{"<name>":{"type":"local","command":"...","args":[...],"env":{...},"tools":["*"],"timeout":<ms>}}}.
- A workspace .mcp.json or .github/mcp.json loads only in a trusted folder; untrusted, `copilot mcp list` shows only user servers.

DELIVERABLE, in both wrappers with identical strings:
1. Detection: CLI type copilot; MOE_WORKER_TYPE=COPILOT exported like the other four.
2. Protected runtime (MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1): the allowlist and its refusal line become claude, codex, gemini, grok, copilot. protected_resolve_cli / Resolve-MoeProtectedCli already resolve a bare name. JetBrains' enum-derived PROTECTED_AGENT_COMMANDS gains copilot in the JetBrains slice.
3. Role polarity as claude and grok: architect/governor open the TUI, worker/qa run headless; --interactive / --no-interactive (ps1 -Interactive / -Interactive:$false) override it. No new exec flag. A copilot TUI disables polling like grok's.
4. Per-launch MCP config: one JSON file in the wrapper's secure temp dir (never in the project, so no DENY or .gitignore entry), passed as --additional-mcp-config @<file>. Server `moe` = the proxy, env MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE=underscore plus every seat and identity key that is set, as codex_moe_server_override lists them (MOE_PROJECT_PATH, MOE_WORKER_ID, MOE_WORKER_TYPE, MOE_SESSION_ID, the MOE_ATTEMPT_ID/MOE_ATTEMPT_GENERATION pair both or neither, MOE_RUNNER_PROCESS_STARTED_AT, MOE_RUNNER_HOST, MOE_DAEMON_HOST), because whether copilot hands its own env to MCP servers cannot be measured signed out; "timeout" 780000 (the moe long-polls block up to 720 s). Server `serena` = start-mcp-server --context agent --project <Serena root> as write_gemini_config builds it, only when Serena resolves.
5. Headless: copilot <argv> -C <CLI root> --allow-all --no-ask-user --no-auto-update --disable-builtin-mcps --additional-mcp-config @<file>, with grok's prompt-file content (SYSTEM_APPEND + per-iteration session context) on stdin. PowerShell must hand it over as UTF-8 (PS 5.1 pipes ASCII by default; reuse the global OutputEncoding save/restore at about moe-agent.ps1:1884). TUI: the same minus --allow-all and --no-ask-user (the operator approves, as in the claude and grok TUIs), plus -i <short quote-free pointer at the prompt file>. The CLI runs in CLI_ROOT (the task worktree in worktree mode).
6. A missing CLI prints one line `[ERROR] MOE_COPILOT_NOT_FOUND: ...` naming the command and the fix (npm install -g @github/copilot, then copilot login) and exits 1.
7. Under verified-local, the existing catch-all refuses a copilot worker or QA seat (MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_CLI_UNSUPPORTED ... this seat runs copilot ...).

TESTS. scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.{sh,ps1} already run every CLI to its launch with recording fakes (vmr_run). Add a fake copilot that also records stdin and the @file's JSON, plus rows: headless worker, architect TUI, --no-interactive architect, C3 verified-local refusal, not found. scripts/tests/protected-agent-command.test.mjs: the refused line with five names, plus a copilot bare-name row.

NOT IN SCOPE: the argv probe, the sign-in line, --model/--reasoning-effort, --log-dir and the parity-check pins (the guards slice); JetBrains and VS Code (their slices); docs (the docs slice and task-59e1d150); a TOOL witness (copilot lands like Gemini and Grok); Claude account rotation (claude only); an installer -AgentCommand copilot.

VERIFICATION (gate budget 20 min; recipe in mem:decision-mid-epic-launcher-gate-narrow): bash scripts/tests/postflight-vm-route.sh; postflight-vm-route.ps1 on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7; node --test scripts/tests/protected-agent-command.test.mjs; bash -n and ParseFile on both wrappers; bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh; npm run lint.
definitionOfDone: With --command <dir>/copilot (also copilot.exe or copilot.cmd), moe-agent.sh and moe-agent.ps1 launch copilot, never claude's argv, with MOE_WORKER_TYPE=COPILOT in the CLI's env, proven by postflight-vm-route.{sh,ps1} rows on bash, Windows PowerShell 5.1 and pwsh 7

A worker seat runs headless: argv has -C <CLI root> --allow-all --no-ask-user --no-auto-update --disable-builtin-mcps --additional-mcp-config @<file>, the prompt arrives on stdin, and <file> is JSON whose moe server env holds MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE=underscore, MOE_WORKER_ID and MOE_WORKER_TYPE=COPILOT and whose serena server runs --context agent; same rows
An architect seat opens the TUI with -i <pointer prompt> and without --allow-all, with polling disabled; with --no-interactive (-Interactive:$false) it runs headless; same rows
A missing copilot prints exactly one MOE_COPILOT_NOT_FOUND line and exits 1, and under verified-local a copilot worker seat is refused with MOE_VERIFIED_LOCAL_CLI_UNSUPPORTED (row C3); same harnesses
Under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 copilot runs by bare name and the refusal line lists claude, codex, gemini, grok, copilot, proven by scripts/tests/protected-agent-command.test.mjs on bash and pwsh

The gate passes: postflight-vm-route.sh on bash, postflight-vm-route.ps1 on 5.1 and pwsh 7, protected-agent-command.test.mjs, bash -n and ParseFile on both wrappers, bash scripts/tests/parity-check.sh and npm run lint

implementationPlan.description:
scripts/moe-agent.sh, the per-launch MCP config and the copilot launch branch.
(a) New write_copilot_mcp_config FILE SERENA_ROOT beside write_gemini_config: one $PYTHON_CMD quoted heredoc, every value by argv (FILE, $PROJECT, $PROXY_CMD, $PROXY_ARGS, $SERENA_CMD, SERENA_ROOT, $WORKER_ID) and the identity keys from os.environ. It writes {"mcpServers":{"moe":{"type":"local","command":PROXY_CMD,"args":[PROXY_ARGS] (only when set, as write_gemini_config),"env":ENV,"tools":["*"],"timeout":780000}}}. ENV = MOE_PROJECT_PATH (the control $PROJECT), MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE=underscore, MOE_WORKER_ID, then each of MOE_WORKER_TYPE, MOE_SESSION_ID, MOE_RUNNER_PROCESS_STARTED_AT, MOE_RUNNER_HOST and MOE_DAEMON_HOST that is set and non-blank, and MOE_ATTEMPT_ID + MOE_ATTEMPT_GENERATION both or neither (codex_moe_server_override's key list; whether copilot hands its own env to MCP servers cannot be measured signed out). 780000 ms because the moe long-polls block up to 720 s. Add "serena":{"type":"local","command":SERENA_CMD,"args":["start-mcp-server","--context","agent","--project",SERENA_ROOT,"--enable-web-dashboard","false","--enable-gui-log-window","false"],"tools":["*"]} only when SERENA_CMD and SERENA_ROOT are both non-empty.
(b) Per-launch Serena root: at the per-iteration reset (`CLI_ROOT=""; unset MOE_WORKTREE_PATH MOE_TASK_BRANCH MOE_LAND_TARGET`, about :10402) set COPILOT_SERENA_ROOT="$SERENA_PROJECT"; in prepare_worktree_launch's `case "$CLI_TYPE" in codex|gemini|grok)` add `copilot) COPILOT_SERENA_ROOT="$serena" ;;` (W, KEEP's root, or '' when Serena is off for the launch), so a worktree seat's Serena works in W, never the control checkout.
(c) New `elif [ "$CLI_TYPE" = "copilot" ]; then` branch before the claude else (after grok's, about :11840-11938), modeled on grok's:
- `command -v "$COMMAND_BIN"` fails: `printf '%b[ERROR]%b %s\n' "$RED" "$NC" "MOE_COPILOT_NOT_FOUND: GitHub Copilot CLI not found: $COMMAND_BIN. Install it (npm install -g @github/copilot), then sign in with copilot login." >&2; exit 1` (printf, not echo -e, as the agy line).
- Prompt body by grok's rules (AUTO_CLAIM: $PROMPT; else grok's ROLE_WORKFLOW sentence; a shared helper is fine only if grok's launch stays byte-for-byte the same). COPILOT_PROMPT_FILE="$(create_secure_temp)/copilot-prompt.md" gets `printf '%s\n\n# Session Context (per-iteration)\n%s' "$SYSTEM_APPEND" <body>`; COPILOT_MCP_FILE="$(create_secure_temp)/copilot-mcp.json" via write_copilot_mcp_config "$COPILOT_MCP_FILE" "$COPILOT_SERENA_ROOT". Both live only in the secure temp dir (cleanup_temp removes it), never in the project, so no DENY or .gitignore entry.
- Error handling: a failed prompt or config write, or an empty PROXY_CMD, prints exactly one `[ERROR] MOE_COPILOT_CONFIG_FAILED: cannot write <file>; refusing to launch copilot without its prompt and moe server.` on stderr and exits 1 (for the empty PROXY_CMD case name moe-proxy instead of a file). Never launch copilot without its moe server.
- Headless (COPILOT_INTERACTIVE=false): print a Command: line (never the prompt), then under set +e: `(cd "${CLI_ROOT:-$PROJECT}" && agent_git_exec "$COMMAND_BIN" "${COMMAND_ARGV[@]}" -C "${CLI_ROOT:-$PROJECT}" --allow-all --no-ask-user --no-auto-update --disable-builtin-mcps --additional-mcp-config "@$COPILOT_MCP_FILE" < "$COPILOT_PROMPT_FILE")`, CLI_EXIT_CODE=$?, set -e. The prompt never rides argv: copilot reads stdin when -p is absent, and Windows caps a command line at 32 KB.
- TUI: the same argv minus --allow-all and --no-ask-user (the operator approves, as in the claude and grok TUIs), plus `-i "$pointer"`, where pointer is grok's sentence naming $COPILOT_PROMPT_FILE ('Session context (routed mentions, pre-flight data) is in <file> - read it. If a routed_mentions block is present, reply to each tagged message via moe.chat_send as workerId <id>. Then follow your role doc.'). stdin stays the terminal.
- Keep this argv order exactly: the harness rows assert the arrays. bash -n again.
implementationPlan.note: Added per-launch temporary MCP JSON (explicit identity, paired attempt vars, launch-specific Serena root) and stdin/TUI dispatch with fail-closed write/proxy checks. bash -n exit 0. Ponytail found in control .moe/skills and loaded (correcting step 1 note); reused grok behavior without changing grok. Runtime regression coverage is next approved step.

implementationPlan.description:
scripts/moe-agent.ps1, the twin of steps 1-2 (same strings, same argv order). Keep the file UTF-8 with BOM (the vm-route harness checks it); locate by quoted text, since task-98053b89 edits this file too.
(a) Protected allowlist: `$Command -cnotin @('claude', 'codex', 'gemini', 'grok', 'copilot')` and the five-name refusal text of step 1. Resolve-MoeProtectedCli resolves a bare copilot (on Windows .ps1 first, then PATHEXT; npm's copilot.ps1 shim forwards piped input).
(b) Detection (about :1228): `elseif ($cmdBase -eq "copilot") { $cliType = "copilot" }`; MOE_WORKER_TYPE then follows from ToUpperInvariant (COPILOT).
(c) Beside $grokInteractive (about :1323): `$copilotInteractive = ($cliType -eq "copilot") -and $Interactive` (role default plus -Interactive / -Interactive:$false).
(d) Banners and the polling-disable condition beside grok's (about :9044-9067), with step 1's banner strings.
(e) The architect multi-task condition (about :10913) gains $copilotInteractive; the $oneShotSession switch gains `'copilot' { -not $copilotInteractive }`; the INTERACTIVE-suffix list `@('claude', 'grok', 'codex', 'gemini')` gains 'copilot'.
(f) Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand: replace `& $Command @args` with `if ($MyInvocation.ExpectingInput) { $input | & $Command @args } else { & $Command @args }`. Probed 2026-11-05 on 5.1.26100 and 7.6.9 (mem:gotcha-ps1-native-stdin-utf8): ExpectingInput is true only when input is piped in, and false for unpiped, output-piped and captured calls, so every existing caller and the bodies prompt-cache-launcher/usage-launcher tests lift behave as today.
(g) Per-launch Serena root: at the per-iteration reset (`$script:cliRoot = "$projectPath"`, about :10128) set `$script:MoeCopilotSerena = $serenaProject`; in Initialize-MoeWorktreeLaunch's per-CLI switch add `'copilot' { $script:MoeCopilotSerena = $serenaProject }` (there the function-local value: W, KEEP's root or '').
(h) `elseif ($cliType -eq "copilot")` branch before the claude else (after grok's, about :11358-11485):
- Not found: `[Console]::Error.WriteLine("[ERROR] MOE_COPILOT_NOT_FOUND: GitHub Copilot CLI not found: $Command. Install it (npm install -g @github/copilot), then sign in with copilot login.")`, `$script:MoeExitStatus = 1; exit 1` (never Write-Error: it throws under Stop, as the agy branch notes).
- Directive and file body by grok's rules ($systemAppend + Session Context + $dynamicContext + directive). $script:CopilotPromptFile = TEMP\moe-copilot-prompt-$Role-$myPid.md and $script:CopilotMcpFile = TEMP\moe-copilot-mcp-$Role-$myPid.json (never a moe-mcp-config-* name, which protected-agent-command's mcpWritten counts), both written UTF-8 without BOM. The JSON has step 2's shape: moe command and args taken from $mcpConfigObj.mcpServers.moe (do NOT write a third `command = $(if ($script:MoeNode) ...` expression: test S1 counts exactly 2 JSON writers), serena from $serenaPath plus $script:MoeCopilotSerena with --context agent, env from $env: with the same keys and the attempt pair both or neither. Use ConvertTo-Json -InputObject ... -Depth 6 (probed: keeps one-element arrays and the number on both engines).
- Error handling: any throw in either write prints step 2's MOE_COPILOT_CONFIG_FAILED line via [Console]::Error.WriteLine and exits 1, before the heartbeat starts.
- Then Start-HeartbeatSidecar, try/finally Stop-HeartbeatSidecar, Push-Location -LiteralPath $script:cliRoot, as grok. Headless: save $global:OutputEncoding and [Console]::OutputEncoding, set both to New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false) (the :1884 pattern; 5.1 otherwise pipes ASCII, probed: 'café —' arrived as 'caf? ?'), run `$copilotFileBody | Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand @CommandArgs -C "$script:cliRoot" --allow-all --no-ask-user --no-auto-update --disable-builtin-mcps --additional-mcp-config "@$($script:CopilotMcpFile)"`, $script:CliExitCode = $LASTEXITCODE, and restore both encodings in finally. executionContract.intendedBehavior: agentCommand copilot (the base name of any path, .exe/.cmd stripped) runs GitHub Copilot CLI in both launchers instead of falling through to claude's argv, and the seat exports MOE_WORKER_TYPE=COPILOT. Worker/qa seats run headless: copilot <argv> -C <CLI root> --allow-all --no-ask-user --no-auto-update --disable-builtin-mcps --additional-mcp-config @<temp JSON>, with the prompt file's content (SYSTEM_APPEND plus the per-iteration session context) on stdin, as UTF-8 on every PowerShell engine. Architect/governor seats open the TUI: the same argv minus --allow-all and --no-ask-user, plus -i <a short pointer at the prompt file>, and polling is disabled. --interactive/--no-interactive (-Interactive / -Interactive:$false) override the role default. The per-launch JSON lives in the wrapper's temp dir, never the project. It names server moe (the proxy; env MOE_TOOL_NAME_STYLE=underscore plus the seat and identity keys; tools ["*"]; timeout 780000) and, only when Serena resolves, serena with --context agent on the launch's Serena root (W in worktree mode). A missing CLI prints one MOE_COPILOT_NOT_FOUND line and exits 1; a failed prompt/config write prints one MOE_COPILOT_CONFIG_FAILED line and exits 1. Under MOE_RUNTIME_PROTECTED=1 copilot is allowlisted by bare name. Verified-local refuses a copilot worker/qa seat through the existing catch-all.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
- Prompt on argv (-p): rejected. Windows caps a command line at 32 KB, and copilot reads stdin when -p is absent (measured).
- A project-scoped .mcp.json or .github/mcp.json: rejected. It loads only in a trusted folder, so the plan uses a per-launch --additional-mcp-config @<temp file>, which needs no trust and no DENY or .gitignore entry.
- Deriving the launch's Serena root by re-reading claude's MCP config (sh .mcp.json, ps1 $mcpConfigFile): rejected, because it couples copilot to claude's file. An explicit COPILOT_SERENA_ROOT / $script:MoeCopilotSerena, reset per iteration and set in the worktree launch's per-CLI dispatch, is two lines per wrapper.
- A third ps1 JSON writer with its own node pin: rejected. protected-agent-command S1 counts exactly two; reuse $mcpConfigObj.mcpServers.moe.
- A --copilot-exec flag: rejected by the task (claude/grok polarity, --interactive/--no-interactive override).
- A copilot-specific tool-naming line in SYSTEM_APPEND, model/effort flags, an argv probe: out of scope (the guards slice and the closing row task-59e1d150).
- Proving .exe launch on Windows: no fake .exe is practical. The ps1 copilot.cmd fake proves the launch, and CP-NF's missing copilot.exe proves the detection.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- The CLI dispatch is an if/elif chain on CLI_TYPE ($cliType). grok is the closest model: a role-polarity TUI, a prompt file plus a pointer, and a not-found check inside the branch after the claim. The verified-local check refuses any CLI other than claude/codex through a catch-all, so copilot needs no change there.
- Per-iteration resets: sh `CLI_ROOT=""` (about :10402), ps1 `$script:cliRoot = "$projectPath"` (about :10128). Worktree launches override them in prepare_worktree_launch / Initialize-MoeWorktreeLaunch, whose Serena root is a LOCAL there: W, KEEP or '' (OFF when the .serena/memories link fails, e.g. a control checkout without that dir).
- ensure_mcp_config runs for every CLI and sets PROXY_CMD/PROXY_ARGS/SERENA_CMD/SERENA_PROJECT. The ps1 $mcpConfigObj.mcpServers.moe holds the pinned node and proxy.
- sh agent_git_exec is a subshell that execs, so a `< file` on the call reaches the CLI. ps1 Invoke-MoeGuardedCommand is a simple function (`& $Command @args`). Both lifted copies of it in prompt-cache-launcher/usage-launcher tests are unpiped.
- Harness knobs: sh vmr_run ROW ROLE CLI READINESS WTMODE SEAM [VAR=VALUE...] with the VMR_ARGS/VMR_CMD/VMR_SETUP globals; ps1 Invoke-VmrRow with $script:VmrLoop/VmjExtraArgs/VmrCommand/VmrSetup. The fake proxy serves task-postflight, and FAKE_CLAIM_WORKSPACE/FAKE_CTX_WORKSPACE give a worktree claim. A -NoLoop/--no-loop run never prints 'Interactive mode: polling disabled', so CP-A runs with a positive poll interval.
- The worker prompt bodies in both wrappers contain U+2014, a free UTF-8 probe for the stdin route.
- Gate timing measured on the current tip (2026-11-05): 522 s; the Windows protected run took 237-246 s and the bash protected run 32 s.
